landing.title: Preserved Forever. Altered by No One.
landing.subtitle: Permanently archive, verify, and retrieve any digital content for AI, research, and compliance.
landing.project_goal_desc:
The future of AI depends on trusted data.

SuperArchive provides the infrastructure layer that allows AI systems, organizations, and individuals to preserve and verify digital knowledge permanently.

By combining decentralized permanent storage with cryptographic verification, SuperArchive transforms ordinary digital content into reliable, immutable knowledge assets.
landing.free_tier_desc: Every registered user receives 10 free uploads daily for files smaller than 91KB. Free tier uploads are securely queued and processed via the blockchain with a 3-second delay, 100% free of charge.
landing.description: Upload to the blockchain, permanently saved without loss.
landing.free_quota_detail: Single files smaller than 91KB, with less than 10 uploads daily, are automatically queued and safely uploaded via the blockchain with a 3-second delay, 100% free.
landing.security_title: In the AI Era, Is Your Data Really Safe?
landing.security_p1_title: Attackers Are Always Faster Than Defenders
landing.security_p1_desc: With AI, attackers can find and exploit vulnerabilities faster than ever before. Defenders' patches are always one step behind.
landing.security_p2_title: Your NAS Can't Guarantee Your Data Is Always Safe
landing.security_p2_desc: Synology itself has warned that attackers are exploiting a vulnerability patched back in December 2024 to target NAS devices running outdated DSM, encrypting users' data and demanding ransom. You might not care about a data leak, but you definitely don't want to lose your data.
landing.security_p3_desc: SuperArchive is built on Arweave's permanent blockchain storage: every file you upload is preserved permanently and cannot be lost or modified. Encrypt it yourself before uploading, and it can't be leaked either.
